subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Catfishing: Living Behind a Mask
description: One-minute skill: Catfishing: Living Behind a Mask.

hook.text: You've dated someone online for a year. Their photos are real — they just belong to someone else.

buildup.text: Catfishing means creating a false identity online to deceive someone in a relationship.

discovery.text: Reverse image search can often reveal that a profile photo belongs to a model or influencer.

twist.text: Not all catfishing is financial. Some catfish seek emotional connection they can't get as themselves.

climax.text: Whether for money or attention, catfishing causes deep emotional damage to the deceived.

punchline.text: The face was borrowed. The lies were original.

quiz.question: What is catfishing?
options: Creating a false identity online to deceive someone romantically
